name: zclass_clear_damage_handler_recursive
description: zClass_Node::ClearDamageHandlerRecursive clears a matching damage handler from a node subtree.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this recursive helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass damage-handler source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b2670 validates recursive traversal of listB with the same handler, a post-order comparison against the node damageHandler slot, and clearing only matching slots.
The native smoke verifies a root-child-grandchild subtree receives a shared damage handler and ClearDamageHandlerRecursive removes that handler from all three nodes.
